info.title: MigrationScan
info.description: Find out what it costs to move a .NET Framework solution to modern .NET. The report names what blocks the migration, sizes each item in engineer-days, and grades how far to trust each finding. It runs with no network, no account, and no source code leaving your machine. One scan prices both options: stay on Windows, or go cross-platform.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: MigrationScan — a free, deterministic, offline .NET Framework migration assessment tool.

options.name: --target
options.description: The .NET version to assess against. The JSON report always covers both portability stances; this picks the one the console and Markdown describe. A '-windows' TFM (e.g. net10.0-windows) marks Windows lock-in findings (COM, P/Invoke, Registry, WMI, …) as satisfied — still listed, but not counted or estimated. [default: net10.0]

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format(s): console | json | markdown | sarif. Repeatable. Omit for the default: a console summary plus migrationscan-report.json. [default: System.String[]]

options.name: --output
options.description: Write file-based formats (json, markdown, sarif) here instead of stdout. A directory receives report.<ext>; with multiple formats a file path is disambiguated by extension.

options.name: --fail-on
options.description: Exit with code 1 if any finding is at least this severe: blocker | high | medium | low.

options.name: --baseline
options.description: Suppress findings present in a baseline (a JSON report captured earlier).

options.name: --online
options.description: Allow nuget.org lookups for package status (e.g. deprecations). Off by default; the default path makes no network calls. [default: False]

options.name: --include-paths
options.description: Keep real file paths in the JSON report. Off by default: the JSON replaces them with stable opaque ids so the report can be shared without a review. Console, Markdown and SARIF always keep full paths. [default: False]

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: A .sln, .csproj, or directory to scan recursively. Defaults to the current directory. [default: .]
